coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: Every page is a 1284 x 1662 px scan (151 ppi) drawn over the whole page; lines and squares located on the scan's pixels (plines.py, squares.py in work-g1) and converted through the drawing matrix; every page looked at; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: A scanned Regulation A subscription agreement: the investor fills and signs the one-page signature page (with a joint investor line, capacity choices, joint ownership choices, backup withholding and foreign person boxes); the company accepts on the last page.
